own.rule: each arm: max mean own dev success on dev goals/seeds; divergence = 0; ties -> smaller eta

wide.rule: native: max mean dev-seed success on WIDE.train goals; heldout untouched; ties -> smaller eta; all wide arms at that eta

config.stepRule: lrP = lrV = eta * (1 + next running |h|^2) before every learn()

budgets.note: single 5x5 one-drop family, item at start; wide heldout goals are interior cells
